questions.explanation: By the binomial theorem the coefficient of x^5 in (1+x)^7 is C(7,5)=21. Permutations would apply if order mattered, which it does not here.
questions.hint: Use the binomial theorem coefficient.

questions.learningObjective: Solve an exam-level problem in discrete mathematics from first principles.

stimulus.body: A sequence satisfies a(0)=3, a(1)=1, and a(n)=5a(n-1)+4a(n-2) for n >= 2.

questions.hint: Compute each successive term up to n=6.
